title: Software Developer Intern
summary: Software developer intern on Verisk's Impact team, modernizing legacy .NET CI/CD, containerizing apps and test-runner infrastructure, and building a new product with spec-driven, AI-led development.
highlights: Modernizing legacy .NET CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps and moving applications onto newer .NET technologies and .NET Aspire.
Containerizing applications with Docker and Podman and building the infrastructure for the test-runner environments.
Developing a new product from scratch using spec-driven development with OpenSpec and AI-led engineering techniques.

title: President & Treasurer, Computer Science section
summary: President and treasurer of IAESTE Málaga's Computer Science section; moved local and national websites off WordPress, automated paperless member onboarding and is building an internship-outreach CRM.
highlights: Migrated the IAESTE Spain national website and the IAESTE LC Málaga website off WordPress, cutting recurring costs by €400 per year for the national site and nearly €200 per year for the local site, a large saving for a student-run organization.
Made member onboarding fully paperless and automated the onboarding and registration emails for the local committee.
Building a custom CRM to track the companies the committee contacts to secure internship offers.

title: Team Member · Sole Software Developer
summary: Sole developer of Diana, the iGEM team's guide RNA design software, whose designed guides were ordered and tested in the wet lab.
highlights: Built Diana as sole developer, a Blazor Server (.NET 9) app, F# library and CLI that convert disease variants (HGVS or rsID) into ranked CRISPR-Cas13 guide RNA spacers scored by GC content, homopolymers, Bowtie off-target alignments and ViennaRNA RNA folding.
Guide RNAs designed with Diana were ordered and tested in the wet lab by the iGEM UMA scientific team.
Implemented combinatorial guide pooling (2D fragmented, 2D matrix and 3D models) onto 96/384-well plates, decoding positive wells back to the implicated guides and flagging ambiguous collisions.
Added restriction-site flagging (BsaI, BsmBI, SapI, BbsI, EcoRI, PstI, XbaI, SpeI, EcoRV, NotI) and an order-ready oligo CSV export so designs go straight to synthesis.

Containerized Diana with a two-image Docker build that checksum-verifies and bakes in the GRCh38 index and runs as non-root with a health check, avoiding the more than 10x alignment slowdown of a mounted index.

title: Research Intern
organization: Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences
summary: International research internship in India building a cloud-backed deep learning pipeline for pre-ictal epileptic seizure prediction on EEG data.
highlights: Selected through the IAESTE international exchange for a paid 8-week research internship at Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences (India), supported by a recommendation from a UMA full professor.
Developed a CNN-based deep learning pipeline for pre-ictal epileptic seizure prediction on real patient EEG recordings (CHB-MIT dataset).
Designed Google Cloud-backed workflows for scalable EEG preprocessing and model training.
